Class OfficeRegister

java.lang.Object
university_system.OfficeRegister
public class OfficeRegister extends Object
Central registry for accessing application services. Provides shared instances of all core services used in the system. This class simplifies access to services such as course management, enrollment processing, user management, research operations, and reporting. All services are initialized once using a shared Database instance.
